suitability.rationale: Directly measures purified LIMK1 biochemical activity and appropriately limits inference to enzymatic inhibition. Alternative format compatibility is explicitly acknowledged as assumed.
response_quotes: Purified LIM domain kinase 1 (P53667) with cofilin-2 substrate in vitro
A biochemical IC50 establishes enzymatic inhibition only; it does not demonstrate cellular target engagement or viability effects

procedural_soundness.rationale: Preparation, reaction, ATP depletion, ADP detection and analysis are coherently ordered. Essential concentrations, detection conditions and acceptance thresholds remain unresolved. Compound-only no-kinase wells do not establish sensitivity to suppression of a positive ADP signal. Replicate independence is unspecified; this is an outline requiring validation.
response_quotes: Stop the reaction with ADP-Glo reagent to deplete residual ATP, then add kinase detection reagent and read luminescence.
must be titrated to give linear signal over the reaction window

numerical_soundness.rationale: The provisional 30 µM, threefold, ten-point series is internally consistent and contextually justified by other-compound measurements, without predicting query potency. Assumptions and unresolved settings are clearly separated from supplied facts. The cited 60 minutes appears in retained descriptions, although transfer needs validation.
response_quotes: The concentration series (30 µM top, 3-fold, 10 points) is an explicit assumption
those IC50s are contextual only and are not used to predict CHEMBL1258633 potency.

not_assessable_components: Compatibility and quantitative comparability of reference Kinase-Glo assays with proposed ADP-Glo and purified LIMK1 construct.
Optimal temperature, reagent concentrations, vehicle tolerance, reaction linearity and detection conditions are not established by supplied evidence.
assumption_handling: Unsupported settings are largely labeled assumptions or unresolved. The rationale calls ADP-Glo comparable, but limitations qualify compatibility as assumed rather than evidenced. Triplicates are not identified as technical or independent experiments.

numeric_check.notes: Ten points span 30 to 0.0015241579 µM (1.5241579 nM). No contradictory endpoint is asserted. Contextual 2800–12700 nM correctly converts to 2.8–12.7 µM; query-compound coverage is not established.

review_reason: Assay compatibility, construct selection, operating conditions and detection-interference controls require domain review before execution.
